title: Commander4K folder file (c4k.dir)
description: Placed in a folder: what its quick view (Ctrl+Q) shows and what Enter does. Shift+Enter always opens the plain file list. Comments and trailing commas are allowed.

preview.description: What the quick view of this folder shows.

enter.description: What Enter on this folder does.

action.description: A built-in view name, a plugin id (e.g. official.steam-library), or an object with one target.

plugin.description: Plugin id; installed from the official catalog when missing.

preview.description: The plugin's preview id (contributes.previews); the first one by default.

panel.description: Panel to open: a built-in id (builtin.sysinfo) or the plugin's panel id.

open.description: Path to show instead: sftp://user@host/dir, \\server\share, a relative folder…

user.description: User name for open on SFTP/FTP.

keyFile.description: Private key for open on SFTP; ~ is the user's profile.

url.description: http(s) page shown in the panel browser.

file.description: Markdown file for the markdown view (README.md by default).

options.description: Passed to the plugin as options (preview.render, panel.load).

run.description: A command started in the folder after the user trusts this exact file content. A .ps1 runs with PowerShell 7.

cwd.description: Working folder relative to this folder.

icon.description: An emoji shown when there is no image.

image.description: Picture file, relative to the folder.

open.description: What a click opens; for a card also what it shows.

card.description: Show the tile as a live card: true = the preview Ctrl+Q would pick for open; or a name: files, gallery, notes, markdown, dashboard, api, ssh, or a plugin id (plugin or plugin/preview).

refresh.description: Read the card again every 10s, 5m, 1h… while the dashboard is visible (at least 2 s).

size.description: Card width: one column or two.

api.description: An HTTP request. {secret:name} in a header or the body (not the url) is replaced with a secret stored by the app (never write tokens here). Methods other than GET/HEAD need the user's trust in this file.

path.description: Path in the JSON response: a.b, items[0].name, $ for the whole value.

ok.description: For status: values that mean good.
